thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> service=inference-prod-us-east, alert=high-token-latency, priority=P1
Remy: saw the PD page. It paged infra-team rather than platform-oncall. Is that expected?
Sam (oncall): i got it but i'm on infra rotation today? i think this is wrong routing. ack'ing to stop noise.
Remy: thanks for ack. initial spike looks real in logs tho, requests to /v1/generate elevated 5x. can someone confirm customer impact?
Sarah (CS): i'm seeing multiple customers report slow responses in support ticket stream (ACME-42, BetaCorp). They're getting timeouts ~10s.
Jin: looking at pagerduty service bindings now. quick check: `pd service show inference-prod-us-east` -> `integration_key=XXXXX`, bound_team=infra, routing_key_tag=legacy`. that tag looks wrong, should be `platform-oncall`.
Mike: wow — we recently merged a rotation change that re-tagged new instances with `legacy` accidentally. likely caused the fallback rule to send to infra.
Remy: can we rebind the PD service to the correct schedule? If we re-route, will existing ack be lost?
Jin: re-binding is safe. doing `pd service update --id svc_abc --team platform-oncall` now.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Service update requested by Jin (command logged).
Jin: done. I've patched the binding and triggered a test page to validate. `pd trigger --service svc_abc --incident test-verify-routing`
Pagerbot: Test page delivered to platform-oncall rotation (Sam) and to phone.
Sam (oncall): received test, forwarding to the appropriate oncall. ack'ing real incident now.
Remy: good. can infra roll back the tag change? we need to prevent future misroutes. Mike?
Mike: rolling back the tag change in the infra-deploy job. PR already reverted; redeploying the tagging job now. logs: `deploy/tagger job started -> pod/tagger-9c8b`. ETA ~2m.
Sarah (CS): update for support: telling ACME and BetaCorp that we're aware of latency, routing fixed, mitigation underway.
Jin: also reconfigured PD auto-escalation to respect the service->team mapping so fallback won't keep spamming infra next time.
Remy: monitoring token latency and 5xx rate. currently 5xx spiked to 2.8% at peak, now down to 0.6% after routing fix.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by Sam (oncall). escalation steps executed.
Sam (oncall): I'm doing a short oncall handoff with Jin in 10m but happy to stay until we confirm stable.
Jin: looking at runtime metrics, KV cache thrash correlated with the deploy that changed tags. killing a misconfigured pool cleared backlog. `kubectl delete pod inference-pool-legacy-3`
Remy: can we confirm there was no data leakage or customer-facing incorrect model? any integrity issues?
Mike: no evidence of model swap; this was purely routing/tagging -> wrong responders. no config drift on model binaries.
Sarah (CS): CS notified customers with an ETA of 30m for full verification. they appreciate the quick reroute. :thumbsup:
Remy: action items: 1) postmortem for tagging change (owner: Mike) 2) PD rule audit to prevent tag inversion (owner: Jin) 3) add automated test to CI that validates service->team mapping on deploy (owner: Remy).
Sam (oncall): I'll create a short incident note and handoff to next oncall. If anything else flares, ping me.
Remy: dropping the channel a note: keep this thread for follow-ups, but i'll close the PD incident once we're stable. last check: error rate 0.4%, latency trending down.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Incident resolved signal requested by Remy.
Jin: marking this resolved in PD and creating a short postmortem draft. linking to internal runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pd-routing
Remy: thanks all — good catch and fast mitigation.
Pagerbot: Automation note: queued rule fix scheduled in config-bot for tomorrow, will not affect current service.
Mike: redeploy complete. tagging job back to `platform` tag mapping.
Remy: last_message: will follow up with PM/CS sync. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
